name: NGC 2315, SN 2011ay field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2315, a nearly edge-on galaxy that hosted the Type Iax supernova SN 2011ay, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2011ay-hubble
story: SN 2011ay belonged to the Type Iax supernovae, a newly recognized class of stellar explosion. Hubble returned to its site in this nearly edge-on galaxy to search for a star that such a blast may leave behind.

claims.text: SN 2011ay is a Type Iax supernova
SN 2011ay appeared near the center of NGC 2315, a nearly edge-on galaxy
Type Iax supernovae are a new class of stellar explosion
Program 15166 searches for possible stellar remnants of Type Iax supernovae
